exposure: Postpartum symptom informedness and preparedness typologies (High, High-moderate, Moderate-low)
cohort: Birthing parents, defined as postpartum women and people with various gender identities who give birth, recruited using convenience sampling (N=148).
finding: Median PHQ-4 scores at 4 weeks postpartum were lower among birthing parents in high informedness and preparedness typologies.
mod_finding: The moderate-low preparedness typology had a higher percentage of birthing parents who underwent cesarean section.
cross-section timing: Enrollment and initial survey data collection between November 2020 and June 2021
